title: Pantry
description: Pantry makes food age, spoil, and preserve over world time. Eat older food first, preserve meat with smoking/salting/drying, collect ocean salt water for salt, and manage long-term supplies.
body:
# Pantry

Food slowly ages, cellars matter, and ocean water can be boiled down into salt.

Pantry is built around a small survival pressure: eat your older food first. It adds freshness, spoilage, preservation, salt water, and environmental storage without deleting spoiled food or splitting every loaf of bread into its own stack.

![A Pantry tooltip showing steak freshness, spoilage risk, preservation, spoil time, and storage conditions.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Wn42SyT7/images/69d425e020fdee89af4058997fcae7574259ba14.png)

## Food That Actually Ages

Most food starts fresh and loses quality over world time. Fresh food behaves like vanilla food. Older food becomes aging, stale, or spoiled, with risk depending on what it is.

Spoiled food stays edible. Pantry is meant to make food storage more interesting, not delete your supplies because you forgot a timer.

![A bread slot cycling through Pantry freshness stages.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Wn42SyT7/images/d2809b5c48657649699f7ed3058005bbafdee04f.gif)

## Preservation Without Clutter

Pantry uses batch-based stacking so food with similar freshness can still share a stack. When batches combine, freshness is averaged by stack size instead of letting one old item quietly refresh everything else.

Current preservation includes:

- Smoked food
- Dried food
- Salted food
- Gilded golden foods
- Combined states like Salted + Smoked

Cooking and preservation can help recover food, but badly spoiled food will not come back perfect.

![Smoked steak with a Pantry preservation tooltip.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Wn42SyT7/images/a5723f444c795abe02c68ea33f6f3881550fadda.png)

## Salt From The Ocean

Ocean biome water can be collected as salt water. Buckets, bottles, cauldrons, furnaces, and dispensers all keep the same simple serving math:

- 1 Salt Water Bucket = 12 Salt
- 1 Salt Water Bottle = 4 Salt
- 1 full saline cauldron = 3 bottles

Placed salt water behaves like water, but the salt inside player-made pools is tracked separately. Water can refill; salt does not magically duplicate.

![A furnace boiling a Salt Water Bucket into Salt.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Wn42SyT7/images/dda6dcea62d3fcb8aa2da384eee835f4e6b8b80f.png)

## Cellars And Climate

Food storage now pays attention to the world around it. Good underground rooms slow decay, deeper cellars can help more, vents and open stairways weaken the effect, nearby ice can help, lava and warm depths hurt, and climate adds a light modifier.

Cold and freezing biomes help a little. Hot, dry, and Nether environments make food age faster. High-altitude storage gets a smaller bonus than a proper cellar.

Stored containers get the strongest effect. Carried food, shulkers, and bundles use a reduced version, while Ender Chest contents stay neutral. Copper chests are recognized too, including weathered and waxed variants.

There is no cellar block. If the room feels like a cellar, Pantry tries to treat it like one.

![A Pantry tooltip showing cellar storage slowing food decay.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Wn42SyT7/images/64a48e17a943547a880d4a02e776923617c30f2d.png)

## Configuration

Pantry uses YetAnotherConfigLib for its config screen, with Mod Menu support when Mod Menu is installed. You can tune freshness display, spoilage speed, eating penalties, stacking thresholds, preservation rules, salt-water debug information, and environment behavior.

There is also an optional creative test tab for checking freshness stages and preserved food variants while balancing, testing, or reporting bugs.

## Requirements

- Minecraft Java Edition 26.2
- Java 25 or newer
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer
- Fabric API
- YetAnotherConfigLib
- Mod Menu is optional, but recommended

## Alpha Notice

Pantry is still in alpha. Back up worlds before testing, especially when updating from an older alpha.

Future updates may expand storage blocks, humidity, seasons, fermentation, food aging, preservation methods, and mod integration APIs.
